title: Vibrant Crispy Greek Snapper Fish Pastitsio
description: A rich and crispy Greek dish featuring snapper fish, lacquer glaze, and plant-based friendly ingredients, formed into a pastitsio shape.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cook the pasta according to package instructions and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and add the snapper fish fillets, cooking until browned on both sides.
In a separate saucepan, combine the tomato puree, lemon juice, and vegetable broth, and bring to a simmer.
Stir in the plant-based bechamel sauce and lacquer glaze, and continue to simmer until the sauce has thickened.
In a large baking dish, create a layer of pasta, followed by a layer of the snapper fish fillets, and then a layer of the sauce.
Repeat the layers two more times, ending with a layer of sauce on top.
Bake the pastitsio in the preheated oven for 30 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the sauce is bubbly.
